text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (—It's... hard to breathe.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Final corner! Narita Taishin swings out to the far outside!
Is her positioning looking a bit tough!?

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
With a build like that, getting buried in the pack
means being unable to break free.
Running on the outside is the only choice.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now for the final stretch, every Umamusume kicks into high gear!
Number 7 Walkie Talkie, Number 11 Poisonous,
a fierce battle for the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin is coming too!
Narita Taishin gives chase with everything she's got!!
But will she not make it in time...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line! First place is number 11, Poisonous!
Roars of congratulations echo through the arena!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Narita Taishin finished 5th, huh...
She just can't seem to pull off a win, that girl...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well... can't be helped, right?
Like the commentary said, that's just a disadvantage in a race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Her petite frame—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (A dream... not another one of these...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, geez. This is the absolute worst...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yawn... Taishin-chan...?
What's the matter~...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Creek-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N-No, not really...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Can't sleep?
Shall we go grab some hot milk together~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
J-Just drop it!
I'm going by myself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for waking you. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I've calmed down a bit... but my chest still feels uneasy.
Lately, I've been having nothing but nasty dreams like that.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (My debut race is right around the corner, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Is it because my debut race is coming up so soon?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...Dammit. This is no time
to be feeling anxious...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Today, our true challenge in the Twinkle Series
with Narita Taishin begins at last!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to give Narita Taishin, with her incredible late-race kick,
all the support I can from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's time for training to start.
How long are you going to just stand there—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......Whoa.
Why do you have such an overly intense look on your face?
choice_data_list: Taishin! Let's give it our all starting today!
Taishin! Let's do our best starting today, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? So annoying...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah.
Enough talk, let's just get started already."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Taishin is as cool as ever today.
However—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's the time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's blow everyone away in your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No... You're way too carefree, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Do you really understand
what kind of place the Twinkle Series is?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even among the monsters gathered at Tracen Academy,
only a tiny handful of true beasts are allowed to enter—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's just the kind of race it is, though.
choice_data_list: Still, your legs will definitely carry you through!
Still, your running will definitely hold up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
So easygoing. Carefree. Are you an idiot or what?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...To begin with, just 'surprising' them isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll shove my running right into the faces
of those jerks who call me small.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And then... I'll show them all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our challenge alongside Narita Taishin had begun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, but seriously, can you do something about that overbearing passion of yours? It's stifling.
